verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm Daily serves an llms.txt index at docs.daily.co/llms.txt (HTTP 200) and markdown versions of its docs pages. Those pages tell readers to fetch the complete documentation index from llms.txt, and an openapi.json spec is also published. Together these let an agent be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: independent community or hands-on reports of agents using these docs, and first-party documentation describing agent-oriented doc usage beyond the files themselves.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.daily.co/llms.txt # Daily
Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://docs.daily.co/llms.txt
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.daily.co/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
